_comment: GENERATED-ADJACENT: this is the fragment scripts/qwen-settings.mjs merges into
$QWEN_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json. Qwen extensions cannot carry hooks, so unlike
the Claude plugin's hooks.json this file is not loaded by the host directly —
the installer copies it in, rewriting AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ROOT to an
absolute path. The five events mirror the Claude plugin exactly; only the
PreToolUse matchers differ, because the tool ids do.
ONE INTENTIONAL ASYMMETRY: build-hooks.mjs also emits stamp-spawn-model.mjs
into this directory, and it is deliberately NOT registered here. Qwen's
`agent` tool has no `model` parameter to stamp into, so the binding happens
at install time instead (scripts/qwen-agents.mjs bakes `model:` into each
copied agent file). The hook no-ops under AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_HOST=qwen anyway
— pinned by a test — so registering it later would be safe, not wrong.
check-spawn-stage.mjs IS registered, on the same `agent` tool: it does not
stamp anything, it refuses a spawn of a stage agent the live marker has not
armed. Qwen drives the loop from a model exactly as Claude Code does, so it
has exactly the same skipped-workflow_advance failure to guard against.

PreToolUse._comment: The check-stage evidence recorder — the Qwen mirror of the Claude plugin's. Read tools never reach the guard's matcher above, so a REVIEW stage would leave an empty proof-of-work ledger and have every honest PASS rejected. It only ever allows.

The stage-ask deny — the Qwen mirror of the Claude plugin's. No stage may ask the human: a drive is unattended between the plan gate and the ship gate, so a question dialog opened mid-VERIFY stalls the run on someone who may not be at the terminal. Marker-gated, so an ordinary session asks freely, and fails open on every uncertainty.

The spawn-stage guard — the Qwen mirror of the Claude plugin's. Qwen's subagent spawner is the `agent` tool; the guard blocks spawning a stage agent the live stage marker has not armed, which is how a skipped workflow_advance surfaces before a stage runs instead of as a rejected verdict after it.

PostToolUse._comment: The PLAN GATE follow-up — the Qwen mirror of the Claude plugin's. workflow_advance's park arm returns a `next` line asking for the Approve/Replan/Park question, and prose inside a tool result is what the orchestrator skips; this re-emits it as context beside the result. Qwen registers ONE MCP alias where Claude has two, but the matcher covers both. It only ever adds context, and every uncertainty exits silently.
